title: Information Retrieval Engine
text: Aya built an information retrieval engine over more than 216,000 documents, comparing TF-IDF, BM25+ and SentenceTransformers. The SentenceTransformers approach achieved Recall@10 of 0.4456, Precision@10 of 0.2703 and MRR of 0.5658.

title: Age Prediction with CNN
text: Aya worked on predicting age from images using deep convolutional neural networks.

title: Education
text: Aya studies Vision et Machine Intelligente (Computer Vision and AI) at Université Paris Cité, in the 2025–2027 Master's program. She is seeking a final-year internship in AI/ML Engineering, Data Science or Computer Vision in 2027.

title: Freelance Web Development
text: Aya developed KhademTech, a job-matching application with React, Node.js REST APIs and MySQL. Matching uses skills, location and experience, with skills weighted more heavily.
